slides.head: Welcome to Principals
slides.say: Welcome to Principals. You will sit on the board of a company facing a decision, and your whole board makes that one decision together on your phones.

slides.head: Join and wait for a seat
points: Open the link or scan the code
slides.say: To join, open the link or scan the code and type your name, and once your professor seats you, your phone shows your board and role.

slides.head: Read your briefing and card
slides.say: You get a one-screen briefing and a private role card only you can see, and the card shows what you personally have at stake, which may differ from the company's interest.

slides.head: Talk it out loud
points: Face to face with your board
Share what you choose to share
slides.say: Then you talk it through with your board, face to face, and you decide how much of your card to share.

slides.head: Vote for one option
points: Change it until the Chair locks
slides.say: Each director votes for one of four options and can change that vote until the Chair locks it in, and a tie goes the way the Chair chooses.

slides.head: The morning after
slides.say: The projector then shows the morning after, a newspaper story and a move on the stock screen, and then we reveal the real company behind your board and what it did.

slides.head: Four short questions
slides.say: We finish with four questions for each board and talk through them together as a class.
